role: XCTest suite for the archive's RR splice on re-archive: ArchiveStore.storedRRSeries three-way classification (preserved / noBeatsStored / unreadable) and that a metadata-only re-archive keeps stored beats while a beatless workout stays beatless.
types: ArchiveRRPreservationTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over SessionArchive RR preservation
state: mem:ArchiveRRPreservationTests.archiveDirectory (nonisolated let: a fresh ArchiveRRPreservationTests-<UUID> directory under the temporary directory, per test instance)
toplevel: lazy archive = SessionArchive(directory: archiveDirectory, sleepScheduleProvider: 22:00/8h, sessionMergeModeProvider: .defaultGap) on a private temp directory, so it never shares the App Group index.json with the host app's archive; the merge gap still comes from AppDependencies settings (no mergeGapProvider).

units.does: Async tearDown: removes the test's private archive directory if it exists (a removal failure throws and fails the test), then calls super.
units.entry: XCTest: instance tearDown() async after each test
writes: file:ArchiveRRPreservationTests per-test temp archive directory (index.json, session files)

units.does: Builds an RRSeries of count (default 50) synthetic beats 780-820 ms starting at 1,800,000,000 s.

branches.effect: appends one point and advances elapsed

units.does: Builds a complete 10-minute walk workout HRVSession with no RR data at a fixed 2027 start.
Archives a beatless workout and asserts storedRRSeries classifies it as .noBeatsStored.
